rubric.evidence: Every element/attribute/event name is taken verbatim from shipped Chromium IDL fetched 2026-08-09 (html_install_element.idl at trunk AND branch-heads/7978 — identical; install_result_event.idl; InPagePermissionMixin from html_geolocation_element.idl), not from the explainer sketch — the page explicitly notes where the explainer IDL (ReflectURL installurl) differs from the shipped IDL (installURL/manifestId/manifest). Behavior contracts (attribute precedence installurl-over-manifest, manifestid-alone => invalid_data, invalid URL => invalid_data without network, async bubbling dispatch, forced not-installed appearance) are read from html_install_element.cc; frame/sandbox/policy gates and the ten invalidReason strings from html_capability_element_base.cc; the result mapping from web_install.mojom. The listing-vs-flag-state contradiction (listing 'Enabled by default' vs runtime feature default 'test' with OT hook and Finch path) is disclosed in the warn-block instead of being resolved by guesswork.

Folder v153/web-app-html-install-element matches the milestone=153 listing name 'Web app HTML install element' (id 5152834368700416, category 'Enabled by default', verified 2026-08-09) via the repo slugify rules; the feature appears in no other milestone listing checked (152, 154). H1 uses the listing name.

reference-contract.json declares 9 inventory items (element, 3 content attributes, HTMLInstallElement, InPagePermissionMixin members, installresult event, InstallResultEvent+init dictionary, InstallResult enum) x 9 dimensions, all documented with selectors + sourceRefs; the substantial event contract has its own child route installresult-event/. Self-assessed implementation-sufficient pending integrator review. Deliberately-scoped exclusions are recorded in the contract notes (permissions policy + PEPC presentation restrictions documented as context; their normative surface belongs to the sibling Web Install API page and the PEPC spec).

The two-designs story (manifest vs installurl) is front-loaded in the warn-block with the end-of-life plan (crbug.com/520025525) so readers write against the surviving surface; pre-activation validation (mixin) vs post-activation results (event) are separated exactly as the explainer separates them; honest caveats called out inline: onpromptaction/onpromptdismiss never fire on <install> (crbug.com/533049447), Launch state currently disabled for side-channel reasons (crbug.com/485281836).

Overview: full catalog example (fallback children + delegated bubbling listener + feature detection) plus an isValid/invalidReason observer snippet; child page: constructor/listener forms, delegation example verbatim from the explainer, and a switch-on-result snippet. All in semantic <pre><code>. Two live external demo pages from the chromestatus record's sample_links are linked (both verified 200 on 2026-08-09).

No BCD entry (html/elements/install.json and api/HTMLInstallElement.json both 404, 2026-08-09); webstatus.dev feature 'install' says Baseline limited with an EMPTY support map; web-features install.yml.dist says baseline:false support:{}. Compat table is explicitly labelled interim and compiled from the milestone listing, the API record, the M153 flag state, and the two vendor position issues; fallback-children guidance is stated as the designed degradation path.

Zero unlinked source labels: every citation is a direct <a href> to the artifact (Chromium gitiles files incl. the M153 branch ref, WICG explainer files, PEPC spec anchors, mojom, about_flags.cc, permissions_policy_features.json5, webstatus.dev + its API, web-features yml, standards-position issues, crbug/issues.chromium.org bugs, sample pages). The chromestatus record's docs.google.com doc_link was deliberately not cited (access not verifiable). External links use target=_blank rel=noopener.

Single h1, sequential h2/h3 outline (attributes are h3 under Syntax); baseline banner uses role=note with aria-label; all tables use th scope=row or thead th; code examples are real text; colors come exclusively from the shared stylesheet variables (WCAG AA per repo invariant #5); crumbs give a same-site path back to /v153/ and the parent page.

h1/lede/inline code use overflow-wrap:anywhere for long tokens (installresult-event URLs, manifest URLs); every table sits in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} with table-layout:fixed + min-width guard; pre blocks scroll internally. Desktop 1280px screenshots of both routes captured and read during self-verify (no horizontal page overflow, banner/warn-block/tables render correctly); narrow-viewport pass is the integrator's responsive matrix step.

The showcase feature route https://chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v153/web-app-html-install-element/ returned 404 and the showcase /v153/ index does not list the slug (both checked 2026-08-09), so no iframe is embedded; the page links the showcase route as pending in See also and substitutes the two live external sample pages from the chromestatus record.

guidanceConsulted.query: reference documentation tables code blocks responsive mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic sizing and contained overflow rather than fixed dimensions; wide content scrolls inside its own container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} around every table with table-layout:fixed and overflow-wrap:anywhere on cells; pre blocks scroll internally; no fixed pixel widths beyond min-width guards; page body never scrolls horizontally.

guidanceConsulted.query: progressive enhancement fallback content for unsupported HTML element capability detection
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Structure documents semantically and lean on native fallback behavior for unsupported elements; feature-detect before wiring behavior.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the page documents and demonstrates the element's own fallback-children model (unknown element renders children), and the example feature-detects with 'HTMLInstallElement' in window before attaching listeners rather than assuming support.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible event-driven button install prompt status messaging screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic HTML with correct roles, sequential heading outline, scoped table headers, and text-based examples; convey status changes in text, not color alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: role=note + aria-label on the Baseline banner, th scope on all tables, single-h1 sequential outline, all statuses conveyed as text labels; the element's own a11y contract (button role, tabindex 0, localized label) is documented from the explainer.

openQuestions: The milestone=153 listing says 'Enabled by default' but the InstallElement runtime feature is status 'test' (with an origin-trial hook and Finch base-feature path) at trunk and on branch-heads/7978, and the ChromeStatus record still says 'Proposed' with origintrial:false — what is the actual M153 rollout mechanism? Re-check at/after 153 beta/stable promotion and update the warn-block and compat row.

crbug.com/520025525 removes the installurl code path and renames manifestId to id — when it lands, #attr-installurl must be marked removed (with version), the IDL block refreshed, and #attr-manifestid retitled.

Does an official Chrome origin trial listing for 'InstallElement' exist? The runtime-features entry carries origin_trial_feature_name InstallElement (win/mac/linux/chromeos) but no public OT registration page was verified; the page deliberately does not claim an active OT.

Secure-context requirement: not explicitly stated in the sources read (the IDL has no [SecureContext] and the explainers don't say); the page deliberately makes no claim either way — verify against the backend WebInstallService binding requirements.
Whether same-origin iframes gain support later (crbug.com/490139152) and whether the 'Launch' presentation ships once the width side-channel mitigation lands (crbug.com/485281836).

summary: Full Case-B reference for the <install> element grounded in shipped Chromium IDL/implementation (trunk + M153 branch) and the WICG explainers, with one child route for the installresult event contract. Honest gating story: listing says enabled-by-default, source says test-status + OT/Finch hooks; Safari opposes; no BCD/Baseline data yet. Showcase demo not yet built (404) — external live samples linked instead.
